title: Chicken Breasts Baked With a Parmesan Crust
description:
By Lidey Heuck: These crunchy, cheesy breaded chicken breasts are baked, not fried, making for hands-off cooking and easy cleanup. Instead of relying on a typical three-part dredge — with flour, eggs and bread crumbs — this recipe uses mayonnaise to help the bread crumbs adhere to the chicken. The mayonnaise does the job beautifully, adding flavor and moisture in the process. Tossing the panko-Parmesan mixture in olive oil helps the bread crumbs brown in the oven, mimicking the crisp texture of a fried cutlet but with way less oil. Serve with a simple green salad (maybe with balsamic vinegar) or your favorite sauce for dipping, as these breaded chicken cutlets are essentially large-format, dinner-friendly chicken tenders.
You could also use this technique with eggplant or zucchini slices.
ingredients: 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts (about 8 ounces each)
1 teaspoon each onion powder and garlic powder (to taste)
1 teaspoon dried Italian herbs or dried oregano (to taste)
¼ cup mayonnaise (or a thick Caesar Dressing)
directions: Heat oven to 425 degrees. Line a sheet pan with parchment paper or a silicone mat, and spray or put a little oil on it. Let it heat up in the oven.
Pat chicken dry with a paper towel, then carefully slice each breast in half horizontally, forming 2 thin cutlets. (You’ll have 4 total pieces.)
If necessary, use a meat mallet or rolling pin, pound the cutlets to a uniform thickness. Season with and little salt and pepper.
In a large, shallow bowl or rimmed plate, combine the panko, Parmesan, and dried spices, maybe a dash of salt to taste. Add oil and toss until the bread crumbs are evenly coated.

Working one at a time, brush each chicken cutlet all over with 1 tablespoon mayonnaise, then dip into the panko mixture, turning and pressing gently until fully coated. Place the breaded chicken on the prepared pan and bake about 20, flipping halfway through, until browned and cooked through.
Sprinkle lightly with salt and serve hot or warm.
